text: Design is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates creative thinking, technological application and humanistic aesthetics, aiming to solve problems, convey information or enhance life experiences through visual, spatial, product and interactive forms. The core lies in being user demand-oriented, combining aesthetic principles, engineering technology and market logic, to create design solutions that are both functional and artistic. The design major covers a wide range of fields. According to different directions, it can be further divided into visual communication design, environmental design, product design, interaction design, fashion design, etc. Each direction has its unique technical system and application scenarios.
